glosses: even (indicating an extreme example of the case mentioned)

examples.text: Não confie em ninguém, inclusive Tom.
examples.en: Don't trust anyone, not even Tom.

examples.text: Todo o mundo riu, inclusive Tom.
Todas as generalizações são enganosas, inclusive esta.
examples.en: All generalizations are false, including this one.

examples.text: Todos, inclusive Tom, estavam sentados à mesa.
examples.en: Everyone, including Tom, was sitting around the table.
